values.description: Direct local Society Service URL when running the app on your computer. For an in-cluster client, use the Kubernetes Service name http://society-service:8080 instead.
Direct local Member Service URL when running the app on your computer. For an in-cluster client, use the Kubernetes Service name http://member-service:8080 instead.

For Postman on your computer. The Gateway Service is private ClusterIP in Kubernetes. Start `kubectl port-forward service/api-gateway 8080:8080 -n emerald-housing` and keep it running; in-cluster applications call http://api-gateway:8080 directly.
